status: Compositor/: every upstream source compiles on Linux. Files that need the Objective-C runtime (#selector, @objc, swizzling, message forwarding) are generated from tip by scripts/gen-objc-overrides.py (selectors by name through compat NSSelectorDispatching); files with a small Linux change are tip plus a patch (scripts/gen-patched-overrides.py, linux/patches). AppKit views inside SwiftUI (NSViewRepresentable) are drawn by the Qt shell through compat SwiftUI's NativeLowering: standard controls become the matching SwiftUI nodes, custom views (the layers table) are drawn as pixels and get the pointer and keys as AppKit events. What is replaced outright is platform work: Metal (CPU/Vulkan backends), the app delegate and Sparkle driver (Qt and Flatpak).
